newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Norilsk's unit mostly ups Jan-Nov output.
newsitem.headline: Russia Norilsk's unit mostly ups Jan-Nov output.

text.p: Production of cathode nickel and refined copper at the main unit of Russia's Norilsk Nickel group, Norilsky metals combine, rose 4.2 percent and 5.8 percent respectively in January-November year-on-year, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday.
It quoted unnamed plant officials as saying cobalt production slipped 3.6 percent over the same period.

A senior Norilsk combine official, contacted by telephone, confirmed that copper and nickel output edged up, while cobalt production was slightly lower in this period year-on-year, but he did not give the exact figures.
"The figures are in line with our actual production levels," he told Reuters.
The combine accounts for more than a half of the group's nickel production and for the bulk of copper and cobalt output.
Last year it produced 93,762 tonnes of nickel, 265,800 tonnes of copper and 1,510 tonnes of cobalt, Interfax said.
